description: Δημοτικό Λιμενικό Ταμείο Νάξου is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δημοτικό Λιμενικό Ταμείο Νάξου. Coverage: Δημοτικό Λιμενικό Ταμείο Νάξου. The portal shows the English title as "Fundo Portuário Municipal de Naxos" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δημοτικό Λιμενικό Ταμείο Νάξου. Its keywords include Δημοτικο λιμενικο ταμειο ναξου, Από μετάπτωση, repository.data.gov.gr, Λιμανι ναξου. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PHP. The listing shows 2026-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
